Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: mg_02592_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

module mg_02592 (input wire reset,input wire generated_clk,output wire [3:0] phy_txd_rising,output wire [3:0] phy_txd_falling,output wire phy_tx_ctl_rising,output wire phy_tx_ctl_falling,output wire phy_gtx_clk,input wire [3:0] phy_rxd_rising,input wire [3:0] phy_rxd_falling,input wire phy_rx_ctl_rising,input wire phy_rx_ctl_falling,input wire phy_rx_clk,input wire mac_tx_er,input wire [7:0] mac_txd,input wire mac_tx_en,output wire mac_tx_clk,output wire mac_col,output wire [7:0] mac_rxd,output wire mac_rx_er,output wire mac_rx_clk,output wire mac_crs,output wire mac_rx_dv);
assign phy_txd_rising = mac_txd[3:0]; 
 assign phy_txd_falling = mac_txd[7:4]; 
 assign phy_tx_ctl_rising = mac_tx_en; 
 assign phy_tx_ctl_falling = mac_tx_en ^ mac_tx_er; 
 assign phy_gtx_clk = generated_clk; 
 assign mac_col = (mac_crs & mac_tx_en) | (mac_rx_dv & mac_tx_en); 
 assign mac_rxd [3:0] = phy_rxd_rising; 
 assign mac_rxd [7:4] = phy_rxd_falling; 
 assign mac_rx_er = phy_rx_ctl_falling ^ phy_rx_ctl_rising; 
 assign mac_rx_clk = phy_rx_clk; 
 assign mac_crs = mac_rx_dv | ( mac_rx_er && mac_rxd == 8'hFF ) | ( mac_rx_er && mac_rxd == 8'h0E ) | ( mac_rx_er && mac_rxd == 8'h0F ) | ( mac_rx_er && mac_rxd == 8'h1F ); 
 assign mac_rx_dv = phy_rx_ctl_rising; 
 assign mac_tx_clk = generated_clk; 
 endmodule
